scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must be a post‑doctoral researcher or a fresh PhD who obtained the PhD within 3 years of the application deadline, or have submitted the PhD thesis
Outstanding researchers without a permanent position or with a career break are eligible
A detailed activity plan covering objectives, execution strategy, and expected outcomes must be provided
An endorsement/consent letter from the host German industry/organisation is required
If the applicant has institutional affiliation, a No‑Objection Certificate (NOC) from the head of the institution must be submitted
A recommendation letter from the mentor at the parent organisation is required (or, if not affiliated, two letters of reference)
The awardee must comply with the conduct, rules and regulations of the German host organisation
The fellowship must commence within 3 months of the result announcement
The awardee/host mentor must inform IGSTC if the fellowship is discontinued before completion
A detailed fellowship completion report with host mentor endorsement must be submitted within 4 weeks after completion
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of €2500 plus up to €1000 for round‑trip airfare and health insurance up to €100 per month.
documents_required: No‑Objection Certificate (NOC) from head of institution (if affiliated)
Recommendation letter from mentor at parent organisation (or two letters of reference if not affiliated)
